summary: Underneath it, an appetite for more and a need to believe in something and an intensity you can't fake and a pull toward control flow together so easily you can take it for granted. It comes naturally — you reach, grow, and lift the room and you go deep and survive what would flatten other people — which is exactly why it's easy to coast on.
body: Underneath it, an appetite for more and a need to believe in something and an intensity you can't fake and a pull toward control flow together so easily you can take it for granted. It comes naturally — you reach, grow, and lift the room and you go deep and survive what would flatten other people — which is exactly why it's easy to coast on. gift: At your best: you reach, grow, and lift the room, and you go deep and survive what would flatten other people.
shadow: The trap: you overreach, overpromise, or talk bigger than you deliver — or you grip too hard, test people, or burn it down before it can leave you.
integration: Let growth and belief and power and transformation cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Big, transformative ambition; the intensity can overshoot.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you reach, grow, and you go deep work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Let the reflex make the decision
